messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)

Zachary, there's no change since Friday. Your Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 is packed at the warehouse but hasn't shipped yet, so there's no tracking number. We'll email you the tracking as soon as it leaves.

Your NerdQaxe++ return reached us on November 9 and is checked in. That's all that was left on the order.

You already told us you want to keep the Bitaxe, so that's settled and you don't need to do anything else.
